While the material is mentioned as a thermoelectric substrate, the content focuses on diffusion studies, interfacial reactions, and thin-film characterization. No thermoelectric property-vs-temperature plots (Seebeck, conductivity, etc.) are provided in the figures, and no thermoelectric property data tables are present. [figure-pass p6-9] The provided pages contain information about AgSbTe2-family compounds, specifically Se-doped AgSbTe2 (Ag25Sb25Se5Te45).
